activities.name: Rule Card
reads: "Nested loops should be avoided for performance reason."
"When a mapper is inside a loop, it can be replaced by a simple mapper with XSLT 'for-each' construct."

activities.name: Rule Card
reads: "Critical Section around JobSharedVariable is useless since a JobSharedVariable is related to a single job."

name: CodeReview/Processes/Review/EFF-003 - Critical Section on single SharedVariable.process

activities.name: Map Data
reads:
$Extract-Project-Structure/lp:project/descendant::lp:process
	[descendant::lp:group[@type = 'criticalSection'  and @more='single' and count(
		descendant::lp:activity[
			(@type='com.tibco.pe.core.SetSharedVariableActivity' or  
			@type='com.tibco.pe.core.GetSharedVariableActivity')
			and lp:info[@name='SharedVariable' and not(contains(., '.jobsharedvariable'))]]
		) = 1]
	]

activities.name: Rule Card
reads: "Critical Section on a single SharedVariable access is useless, SharedVariable activities are thread-safe and critical section should only be used for consistency matters."

activities.name: Rule Card
reads: "Simply add a transition from the concerned activity to another activity or to the End activity."

"When an activity has no transition to another activity, the behaviour of the process at runtime might become undefined. All activities must have at least one successor in the process graph, except the End activity."
